cases.name: AC-1 Continuous Mouse Activity Renews The Session
expected_predicates: Trusted mouse activity renews access within 15 seconds and passes protected validation.
fixture_limits: Input uses requested 100-millisecond intervals; runner overhead affects cadence.

cases.name: AC-2 Continuous Keyboard Activity Renews The Session
expected_predicates: Trusted keyboard activity renews access within 15 seconds and passes protected validation.
fixture_limits: Portal document activity does not prove cross-origin frame propagation.

cases.name: AC-3 Continuous Scroll Activity Renews The Session
expected_predicates: Trusted scroll activity renews access within 15 seconds and passes protected validation.
fixture_limits: The configured portal element supplies the scroll fixture.

cases.name: AC-5 And AC-6 Pending Renewal Closes Only After Success
expected_predicates: Pending renewal closes zero prompts; actual success closes once and passes protected validation.
fixture_limits: A route hold controls request dispatch.

cases.name: AC-7 Rejected Renewal Permits A Successful Retry
expected_predicates: Transport failure preserves the prompt; actual retry installs access and closes once.
fixture_limits: Controlled transport failure does not establish provider rejection.

cases.name: Continuous Activity Crosses The Initial Refresh Expiry
expected_predicates: Activity crosses initial refresh expiry without sign-in or prompt and passes protected validation.
fixture_limits: The short live boundary does not establish the exact four-hour criterion.

cases.name: Hidden And Visible Sessions Recover After Natural Background Time
expected_predicates: After 1,800 seconds, hidden recovery completes renewal while the visible idle control expires.
fixture_limits: Freeze coverage requires an observed freeze event; browser attachment can affect lifecycle.

cases.name: Repeated Activity Shares One Slow Extension Request
expected_predicates: Repeated activity shares one pending extension with zero cancellations and installs actual renewed access.
fixture_limits: A controlled route hold delays the actual extension request.

cases.name: Rapid Extend Input Shares One Renewal Request
expected_predicates: Two pointer attempts create one relogin; pending closure count is zero and successful closure count is one.
fixture_limits: The second native pointer attempt targets a disabled button during a route hold.

cases.name: Keyboard Extend Activation Renews The Session
expected_predicates: Enter activates Extend; actual renewal installs access and closes the prompt once.
fixture_limits: A route hold exposes pending completion before the actual service response.

cases.name: Activity Failure Allows A Later Activity Retry
expected_predicates: A failed activity extension preserves available access; later activity renews against the actual service.
fixture_limits: The first failure is a controlled transport abort.

cases.name: Inconsistent Activity Response Does Not Advance The Session
expected_predicates: A negative body preserves access; a distinct successful retry installs its actual token.
fixture_limits: Diagnostic only: the negative-body and valid-header combination lacks a confirmed deployed contract.

cases.name: Activity Is Ignored While The Timeout Prompt Is Open
expected_predicates: Prompt activity starts zero extensions and closes zero prompts; actual Extend later succeeds.
fixture_limits: The modal can consume physical events before Home receives them.

cases.name: Idle Prompt Logout Clears The Session
expected_predicates: Idle logout clears stored access, leaves no persisted refresh, and returns to sign-in without relogin.
fixture_limits: Storage absence does not establish memory-only refresh cleanup or provider revocation.

cases.name: Quick Background Switch Acquires Refresh Credentials
expected_predicates: A short hidden switch receives one refresh response and preserves authentication on return.
fixture_limits: Browser attachment remains active; this case does not assert natural suspension.

cases.name: Reload After Renewal Preserves The Session
expected_predicates: Reload validation uses the exact pre-reload renewed token and installs its actual usable response token.
Refresh reacquisition and protected validation succeed with zero additional login requests.
fixture_limits: Validation can rotate access. Memory-only refresh reacquisition does not prove refresh persistence.

cases.name: Logout Cancels Pending Manual Renewal And Ignores Late Success
expected_predicates: Logout cancels pending manual renewal; late success restores neither access nor the portal.
fixture_limits: A successful real response is held before browser delivery.

cases.name: Logout Unmounts Home And Cancels Pending Activity Renewal
expected_predicates: Logout unmounts Home, cancels pending activity renewal, and prevents late access restoration.
fixture_limits: Logout and unmount occur together; arbitrary unmount is not isolated.

cases.name: Late Activity Response Cannot Replace Successful Manual Renewal
expected_predicates: Manual renewal survives an older activity response with exactly one prompt closure.
fixture_limits: Actual activity and manual tokens must differ; route delivery is controlled.

cases.name: Actual Expired Credential Cannot Authorize The Protected Operation
expected_predicates: The actual service rejects a naturally expired credential with HTTP 401 or 403.
fixture_limits: A captured read-only request uses the browser context HTTP client; revocation remains outside scope.

cases.name: Observe Background Return Without Refresh Credentials
expected_predicates: Record return state after 1,800 seconds with blocked refresh acquisition and no observed refresh.
fixture_limits: Observation only: absent-credential recovery policy remains unresolved.

cases.name: Observe Saved Workspace Descriptors After Same User Sign In
expected_predicates: Create two workspaces and record descriptor comparison after sign-out and same-user sign-in.
fixture_limits: Observation only: populated application parameters and application-edit retention remain unresolved.
